rogue.summary: The mantle is now skinned. The cap over each shoulder follows the upper arm, and the collar and the front and back panels stay on the chest. In attack2 and victory, the upper arms stay under the mantle. The dagger blades are now about 30 percent longer and 15 percent wider, with the same grip. The forge check shows result ok and ground ok, with a head margin of 0.3 cm.
strengths: In attack2, a raised arm lifts the mantle cap like a pauldron. The arm stays under the cloth, and the mantle does not tear.
The longer blades read as silver lines in the attack2 and victory sprites. The crossed daggers in the victory pose are clear from the front.
The hood, the face, the gold clasp, and the hem stitches still match the mockup, and all 8 clips are present.
issues: In attack2 at t = 0.32 s, the mantle cap over the raised arm still ends in a pointed flap. It looks like a small wing for about 0.2 s.

The top of the left bracer shows through the side of the mantle, also in the rest pose. In victory, the daggers go 0.9 cm into the mantle, and in the attack, the left dagger goes 0.6 cm into the sheath.
At 128 px the blades are still thin, and the old shape issues remain: the hood is very deep from the side, and the tunic is short and plain.
next: Round the mantle hem over the shoulders, so the lifted cap has no corner. Move the bracer in, or the mantle out, so the bracer stays under the cloth.
Move the victory cross pose 1 cm forward, and move the attack slash 1 cm away from the sheaths.

archer.summary: The archer matches the mockup well and now has the full hero clip set. The bow shot draws the string and releases a nocked arrow. The bow is still small and dark.
strengths: The attack draws the string back with a nocked arrow and then releases it. The shot reads clearly in the side view.
In the death clip, the archer staggers, falls on the back, and lies still. The bow drops to the floor next to the body.
The hood point, the elf ears, and the quiver with gold fletching give a clear silhouette in all 8 sprite directions.
issues: In the front view, the bow passes in front of the face while it rises and falls. The check shows a head margin of only 0.3 cm.
The bow and the lower string go 1.0 to 1.9 cm into the tunic and the belt in attack and attack2. The arrow is thin and dark and reads weakly.
The bow is still smaller and darker than the large recurve in the mockup. The hood rim is still thick, and the legs still look short.
next: Make the bow 20 percent larger and use a lighter wood color. This item from the last review is still open.
Move the bow path away from the face and the tunic in attack and attack2. The thinner hood rim from the last review is also still open.

knight.summary: The knight is very close to the mockup and now has the full hero clip set. The helmet, the red plume, the heart shield, and the red cape read clearly at 128 px.
strengths: Steel, gold, and red cloth read as clearly different materials in the model and in the sprites.
The clip set is complete: idle, walk, run, a sword slash, a shield bash, hit, death, and victory. The feet stay planted in the walk and the run.
The shield stays clear of the face at rest, and no held item passes through the head in any clip.
issues: In the victory clip, the raised sword reaches only the brow of the helmet. In the slash, the body hides the sword during the wind-up.
The rig has no knees. The legs stay stiff when he falls and lies on the ground in the death clip.

Small contacts remain: the left gauntlet goes up to 1.1 cm into the cuirass in the death and the shield bash. The helmet has ear discs only, not the cheek guards of the mockup. At 65,322 triangles, the knight is the heaviest model.
next: Add small cheek guards to the helmet.
Move the mail ring pattern into the normal map if the triangle count must go down.

wizard.summary: The wizard is a fire mage with a large red hat, a forked fire staff, and a flame in her left palm. The front matches the mockup well. The back and the staff are simpler than in the mockup. All 8 clips work. The death clip now ends with her flat on her back.
strengths: The hat has a soft wavy brim, a curled tip, a brown band, and a gold flame badge. It gives her a clear silhouette in all 8 sprite directions.
The front has the gold V trim, the belt with the red gem, the flame motifs on the coat, and the cape that flares out on both sides.
In the death clip, she staggers, falls back, and lies flat. The legs lie in line with the body, the coat follows the legs, the cape lies flat under her, and both flames go out.
issues: The back of the cape is one plain red area with only a gold hem. From the back and the side, the hat and the cape merge into one red mass, also at sprite size.
The staff is a thin straight pole with a small fork. In the mockup, the staff is a thick twisted branch that holds the orb. The palm flame is also smaller than in the mockup.

At the end of the death clip, the hat stands upright on her face, and the bare skin at the top of the head shows from the side. In the walk, the long coat hides the legs, so the stride is weak from the side.
next: Add a gold flame emblem and a trim band to the back of the cape, and make the cape a darker red than the hat.
Make the staff a thicker twisted branch with a fork that wraps around the orb, and make the palm flame larger.

cleric.summary: The cleric is a dwarf battle priest with a ginger mane, a braided beard, a large cross hammer, and a holy book. The front silhouette matches the mockup, and all eight clips are done: idle, walk, run, attack, attack2, hit, death, and victory.
strengths: The front silhouette matches the mockup: the large octagonal hammer on the right, the big ginger head, and the book with gold corners on the left.
The attack is a clear overhead smash. The hammer rises behind the head, goes over the top, and hits the ground in front of the dwarf.
The death has a stagger back, a fall, and a rest on the back. The hammer and the book stay in the hands and lie on the ground.
issues: The brows point down at the center and the eyes are large and round, so the face looks stern and young. The mockup face is older and smiles.
The side braids and their rings are short and small, so they do not show in the front view. The hair and the beard are smooth, with few strand grooves.

In the attack, the right bracer goes 0.9 cm into the collar while the hammer is up. The model has 85,000 triangles, which is the highest count of the heroes. In the east and west sprites, the hair covers most of the face.
next: Raise the brows, make the eyes a little smaller, and add heavier lower lids, for an older and friendlier face.
Make the two side braids longer, with larger gold rings, and cut deeper strand grooves in the hair and the beard.

druid.summary: The druid reads as the mushroom girl at once, and all 8 clips pass the check. The staff, the apron, and the belt still differ from the mockup. At 72,196 triangles, she is the heaviest model in the set.
strengths: The large spotted cap with the cream rim and the gills gives a unique silhouette in every view and in all 8 sprites.
The face is very close to the mockup: large brown eyes, pink cheeks, a small smile, and a ginger bob.
The clip set is complete: idle, walk, run, a staff cast, a flask throw, hit, death, and victory. The cap and the lantern lag and overshoot in the hit and the victory.
issues: The staff is still thin and straight, and the lantern is small. The mockup staff is thick and gnarled, with a large lantern on a hook.
The front is plain. The apron is a flat card with one clover, and the three belt pouches and the small hip potion are too small to read.

The attacks read weakly. The staff cast is a flat thrust at hip height with no spell effect, and the thrown flask is small with no splash. At the end of the death clip, the cap stands on its rim and hides the body in the side view.
next: Make the staff thicker and gnarled, and hang a larger lantern from a hook at the top.
Make the three belt pouches and the hip potion larger, and give the apron a scalloped hem with the mushroom motif.

adventurer.summary: The adventurer is a chibi hero with a teal bandana, a red scarf, a leather harness, a short sword, a map, and a large pack with a bedroll and a lantern. It matches the mockup in the face, the clothes, the pack, and the lantern. The hair, the bedroll, and the hand that holds the map differ from the mockup. All 8 clips pass the forge check.
strengths: The face reads at 128 px in the sprites: large brown eyes with highlights, rosy cheeks, and an open smile. The red scarf, the cream shirt, the harness, and the belt match the mockup.
The pack reads from all 8 sprite directions: the teal bedroll, the brass lantern on the side, and the flap with a buckle. The silhouette is clear in every view.

The full clip set is present: idle, walk, run, attack, attack2, hit, death, and victory. The death staggers, pitches forward, and ends face down under the pack. The forge check shows result ok and ground ok.
issues: The front hair stands up in a spiky crown, but the mockup hair sweeps to one side. At the back and the sides, the hair is one smooth mass, like a helmet.
In the attack wind-up (t = 0.2 to 0.3 s), the head and the pack hide the sword in the three-quarter and side views. The blade passes only 0.3 cm from the head.
The legs stay straight in every clip. The death fall tips the body forward as one rigid piece, and the attack2 lunge has no knee bend.
next: Add knee bones, so the run, the attack2 lunge, and the death fall bend the legs.
Sculpt the front hair to sweep to one side as in the mockup, and add separate locks to the back and the sides of the head.

goblin-warrior.summary: The goblin warrior has a new taunt clip of 1.4 s. The goblin points the dagger straight at the player at chest height and puts the left fist on the hip. Then it hops from foot to foot two times, with the head tilted and the ears flicking. Then it turns the blade up, spins the dagger one time in the fingers in 0.25 s, and goes back to rest. The model did not change. The forge check shows result ok and ground ok, and the blade stays 2.4 cm or more from the head.
strengths: The taunt reads in the front and side views: the blade points level at the player, each hop lifts a different foot, and the spin shows the blade up, out, down, and in.
The broad leaf ears, the angry eyes, and the fang read at once. The face reads at 128 px in the S, SW, and SE sprites.
All identity cues of the mockup are present: the nicked ear, one shoulder guard, the diagonal strap, the pouch, the wraps, and the dagger. At 30,374 triangles, the model is light.
issues: In the taunt point, the wrist bends about 90 degrees, because the grip is across the fist. The hops are low (5 cm), because the legs have no knee bones.
In the SW and SE sprites, the far ear still reads as a narrow point above the head.
The belt buckle is still smaller than the large tan buckle in the mockup. The pouch does not show from the back.
next: Add a second new clip (for example a block or a cheer) to get to 8 clips, as the heroes have.
Turn the ears more to the front (about 20 degrees of sweep instead of 32), and make the belt buckle about 30 percent larger.

horned-boar.summary: The horned boar is a strong chibi monster. The hoof soles are now solid black, and the attack is a real gore: a low gather, a 0.2 m charge, and a hooked toss. The short snout in profile is the largest open fault.
strengths: The attack has clear stages. The head drops until the snout is at knee height, and the horns and the tusks point forward. The hips then drive 0.2 m forward, and the head hooks up and to the left.
The legs in the attack use two-bone IK. The hind hooves stay planted and roll onto the toe as the legs push. The front hooves step forward and back, and no hoof slides or goes into the floor.
The shin fur now ends inside the hooves, at y = 0.023. In the death, the raised soles show solid black discs, with no brown ring.
issues: The snout is still short in profile. In the side view and in the W and E sprites, the snout is only a small pink edge, and the head looks flat.
When the head is low in the attack, the lower jaw goes into the front of the chest. From the side, the head and the chest merge into one mass.
Each hoof cleft cuts through the full hoof height. On a raised sole, a thin brown line of shin fur shows inside the cleft.
next: Make the snout 20 percent longer. A longer snout gives a boar profile in the side view, the W and E sprites, and the attack.
Stop the hoof cleft below the hoof top, or fill the hoof inside it with black, so no fur shows in the cleft.

goblin-archer.summary: The goblin archer has its full clip set: idle, walk, run, a bow shot, hit, and death. The shot is now a real bow shot. The goblin nocks an arrow, pulls the string back to the chin, holds, and releases. The hood, the ears, the face, and the leather gear match the mockup.
strengths: The pointed dark hood with the ears through it gives a strong, unique silhouette in every view and in every sprite direction.
The shot reads. The string bends back to the right fist, a nocked arrow shows from the nock to the release, and the string snaps straight when the arrow goes.
The bow cants its top out to the right, so the upper limb stays beside the face. Both eyes stay clear in the front and three-quarter views at full draw.
issues: The short arms and the big hood keep the draw short and low. The right fist anchors under the chin, not at the jaw. In the side view, the hood and the body hide the right fist.
The ears are thin flat plates. In the side views and in the W and E sprites, they read as flat triangles. In the SW and SE sprites, they read as thin sticks.
The model differs from the mockup. It has no long back cape and no chest strap, and the nose is a small bump, not a snout. In the draw, the lower string touches the capelet by 0.9 cm.
next: Give the ears thickness and a cupped inner face, as in the mockup. Then the ears read as ears from the side and from above.
Add the long back cape and the chest strap from the mockup, and keep the lower bowstring clear of the capelet in the draw.

skeleton.summary: The skeleton warrior matches the enemy-sheet design: a grinning skull with glowing eyes under a riveted helmet, a red scarf, mail, a sword, and a round red shield. The chop is now a full sword cut. The body leans away and the blade stands up on the right with its tip above the helmet. The cut then follows through to knee height on the left. The forge check shows result ok and ground ok, with no body contact. The helmet is still dark iron.
strengths: The chop has a clear wind-up, hold, cut, and follow-through. The cut takes about 0.12 s with the edge leading, and the front foot steps in. The blade continues down and across to knee height on the left, slows, and recovers.

In the wind-up, the upper body leans far to the left and the shoulder shrugs, so the blade tip goes about 4 cm above the helmet top in the front view. The blade stays about 3 cm clear of the helmet, and the shield arm tucks out of the blade path.

The death clip tells a clear story, and the slanted black sockets, the amber eyes, and the square teeth make a clear angry skull face. Iron, mail, bone, red cloth, wood, and brass read as different materials.
issues: In the side view, the huge helmet still hides most of the raised blade. Only the tip shows above the helmet at the top of the wind-up.
The helmet is still dark iron all over. The mockup shows lighter steel with dark patches. From above, the dark dome is the largest shape in the sprites.
The model stands in a neutral pose, but the mockup shows a lunge. The mockup has brown leather boots; the model has plain steel feet.
next: Make the helmet steel lighter, with the patina in patches. This item from the old review is still open.
Give the rest pose a small lunge and brown leather boots, as in the mockup.

orc-warrior.summary: The orc warrior is a stocky brute with a heavy scowl, tusks, a topknot, a spiked pauldron, and a large crescent axe. The one-hand overhead chop now hits at the height of a target's body in front of the orc. The follow-through goes down and across the body and stops above the floor. The clip check passes the head test and the ground test.
strengths: The attack reads as a hit on a body: the axe comes over the top, hits level in front of the chest with the edge down, and follows through across the body to the left knee.
The costume matches the mockup: large brown bracers, a spiked pauldron, a belt with a round buckle, a ragged red loincloth, and fur leg wraps.
The death reads well at game size: a stagger back, a fall onto the back, and the axe on the floor next to the hand.
issues: The haft passes near the hair at the top of the swing. The head test passes, but the margin is only 0.3 cm.
The tusks are small: about half the size of the mockup tusks. They hang down from under the upper lip, as the owner asked.
The beard is a small goatee, and the mockup beard is full.
next: Move the haft a little farther from the hair at the top of the swing, for a larger head margin.
Give the beard more volume, toward the full beard of the mockup.

bandit.summary: The bandit has its full clip set: idle, walk, run, a cutlass slash, hit, and death. The model matches the mockup: wild dark hair, an angry glare over a dark red mask, a striped shirt, a leather vest, a loot sack, and a curved cutlass. The slash is now a strong diagonal cut. The gear is still plainer than the mockup.
strengths: The glare between the dark hair and the red mask is a strong focal point. It reads in the front view and in the S, SW, and SE sprites.

The slash has a high wind-up: the chest turns, the weight goes back, and the blade rises over the left shoulder with the tip behind the head. Then the blade cuts on a diagonal from high to low across the body, with the edge leading and a step in on the right foot.
The cutlass clears the head and the hair by 2 cm or more in every clip. The check ends with result ok and ground ok, and the blade does not touch the body in the attack.
issues: The chibi arm is short, so the hand rises only to chin height. In the front view, the raised blade shows only along the side of the head.
The cut is fast (about 0.12 s), and the blade is edge-on to the front camera. In a strip or a sprite frame, the blade at the strike shows as a thin line.

The gear is plainer than the mockup. The mockup has straps on the vest, a holster at the belt, and tall boots with cuffs. The model has a plain vest and short boots. The sack still sits behind the arm.
next: Add the mockup gear: a vest strap with a buckle, a holster at the belt, and cuffs on the boots. Move the sack a little to the side.
Check the attack sprite sheet at 128 px. If the strike frame is weak, add a short smear or a brighter edge on the blade.

zombie.summary: The attack is now a lunging two-hand grab. The zombie sways back with the arms up, lurches 0.19 m forward on the left foot, reaches out with straight arms, and clutches and shakes the target. The hair, the shirt, and the trouser hems are still simpler than the mockup.
strengths: The attack has a clear wind-up, lunge, grab, and recovery. The hips drop in the lunge, and the planted feet do not slide or go into the floor.
The bulging yellow eye and the glossy black eye read in every sprite direction that shows the face.
The walk, the run, and the death read as a zombie at once: one foot drags, the arms stay forward, and the fall ends flat on the ground.
issues: The hair is still a smooth black helmet with thick cone locks. The mockup hair is thinner and messier. In the back sprites, the hair is a large, plain black mass.
The shirt is still plain, with no torn collar, buttons, or loose threads. The trouser tears are still paint, and the sandals are flat planks.

In the attack wind-up, the hands rise only to the brow, because the short chibi arms cannot reach above the large head. The full reach lasts only about 0.07 s, and the stiff swing leg moves out to the side a little.
next: Make the hair locks thinner and more varied, and break up the smooth mass at the back. This item from the last review is still open.
Add a torn collar, buttons, and loose threads to the shirt, and give the sandals a strap and a thicker sole.

slime.summary: The slime is a glossy green jelly dome on a lobed puddle base, with three floating bubbles. The body and the face match the slime king mockup without the crown, the cape, and the chain. The attack is now a real leap: a deep squash, an arc 0.35 m forward and 0.25 m up, a hard splat, and a hop back. The death starts with a strong wobble, and the eyes close and sink before the puddle settles.
strengths: The attack reads as a lunge at the target: the body leaps in an arc, tilts along the arc, splats wide and flat for 0.08 s, jiggles, and hops back. It never slides on the floor.
The death shows a clear wobble of about 13 percent in the first 0.3 s. The eyes squint, shrink, and sink into the jelly, so the puddle has no white crescents.
The face reads at 128 px in the S sprite: big white eyes with lime irises, heavy brow ridges, and a frown. No clip goes below the ground (ground ok).
issues: The mouth paint stays on the jelly, so the melted puddle shows a thin dark line at its front rim.
The puddle keeps a soft dome (about 0.16 m high) to limit the shading streaks, so it reads as a low mound more than a flat puddle. Faint radial streaks still show on its top.
In the front view, a vertical ridge above the small frown reads as a nose. In the side view and the W and E sprites, the eye white sticks out of the profile as a white disc.
next: Hide the frown in the death puddle: put the mouth on its own small body on the eye bones, or fade it with a separate paint layer.
Remove the nose ridge above the frown, and set the eyes a little deeper into the dome so the side profile stays round.

dire-wolf.summary: The cream muzzle is now wider. Above the grin corners it sweeps up and out toward the cheeks, as in the mockup. A lighter grey (furLight) is on the lower cheeks and the chest. The dark face around the eyes stays, so the amber eyes and the cream brows keep their contrast. The jaw split and the clips did not change.
strengths: The wide cream grin now fills the lower face from cheek to cheek, and the grin corners curve up into it.
The cheek cream stays on the head below the grin corners, so the jaw cut has no cream seam, and the jaw opens clean in the attack.
The ears, cheek tufts, and ruff make a spiky outline that reads in all 8 sprite directions at 128 px.
issues: The lighter grey is subtle. The ruff hides most of the light chest, and the base fur is darker than the mid grey in the mockup.
The cheek cream and the lower jaw cream meet at a notch below the grin corners, so the side view shows two cream parts, not one smooth area.
The legs are straight and the side view is longer than the compact mockup. The hit and the death do not open the jaw.
next: Lighten the base fur a little toward the mockup mid grey, and show more of the light chest between the front legs.
Open the jaw in the hit (a yelp) and a little in the death, so all clips use the jaw.

giant-spider.summary: The giant spider is close to the mockup in the front view and reads clearly as a sprite. The big eyes now match the mockup: a bright white eyeball with a red iris about half the eye wide. The attack and the death are unchanged. The attack drive and the fang snap are still open.
strengths: The big eyes match the mockup: the red iris cap is 0.035 on an eye radius of 0.08, so a wide bright white ring shows around it, with a small dark pupil and a highlight.
At 128 px, the front sprite shows two white eyes with small red irises under the heavy brow, so the glare reads clearly.
The attack reads: the spider rears up with the fangs wide, then pitches down and drives 16 cm forward in 0.08 s, and the bite holds for 0.15 s.
issues: The forward drive in the attack stops at 16 cm, not 20 cm. More drive pulls the back legs beyond their reach, and the back feet then slide.
In the attack strip, the fang snap is hard to see from the side, because the low head hides the fangs at the bite.
The mockup irises show no dark pupil. The model keeps a small dark pupil, which adds a little noise at close range.
next: Check the fang snap in a front view of the attack. If it does not read, open the fangs wider at the top of the rear-up.
Try more attack drive with a longer back-leg reach, and keep the back feet planted.

dragon-fire.summary: The fire dragon matches the mmx mockup closely in shape and color: a squat red dragon that is half head, with cream horns, a crest, heavy black brows, a toothy grin, orange bat wings, and a ridged cream belly. The attack is now a fire-breath roar: a jaw bone opens the grin, and a level cone of fire comes from the mouth.
strengths: The spread wings, the horns, and the crest make a unique silhouette that reads in all eight sprite directions.
The attack has a clear draw back (the head tips back, the chest fills, the wings rise), then a 9 cm hop forward with the head level and the jaws wide, and a fire cone at chest height.
The jaw splits along the painted grin, so the closed mouth looks the same as before. The open mouth shows a dark throat, a tongue, and the lower teeth.
issues: The fire cone reads as a smooth orange shape. It has only a small scale flicker, no glow, and no smoke. The textured build loses most of the yellow-to-red gradient.
The jaw opens only in the attack. The hit and the death roars keep the mouth closed, and the mockup smoke puff from one nostril is not in the model.
In the three-quarter view, the death ends with the head and the belly as two separate blobs, and the face lies sideways. The side view of the end pose reads clearly.
next: Give the fire more life: two or three flame tongues with their own flicker, a yellow core, and a short smoke puff when the breath ends.
Open the jaw in the hit and in the death roar, and fix the three-quarter end pose of the death.

blacksmith.summary: The blacksmith matches the mmx mockup in costume and color: a red bandana, a black beard, a leather bib apron with brass rings, big gloves, and a hammer at the right shoulder. The work clip now has tongs in the left fist and a glowing hot billet in the jaws. The hammer face lands flat on the billet at the blow, and the billet flashes. The body is still less burly than the mockup. The check ends with result ok and ground ok.
strengths: The red bandana, the black beard, and the brown apron read at 128 px in all 8 sprite directions.
Dark iron tongs with a rivet and flat jaw pads come out of the left fist. The orange-red billet glows and is easy to see in the side and three-quarter views.
The billet stays still in the world during the loop. The clip samples at 50 frames each second, so a key falls exactly on the blow and the face touches the billet top.
issues: The head is still larger than the torso. In the mockup, the chest and the arms are larger than the head, so the model is less burly than the mockup.
There is no anvil. The billet hangs in the air at thigh height (y 0.16) in front of the belly, held only by the tongs.
The soot mark under the left eye is dark blue-gray and reads as a bruise in the front sprites. The back hair is one plain black mass.
next: Make the chest, the shoulders, and the arms 10 percent bigger. This item from the last three reviews is still open.
Add a small anvil prop or a scene anvil under the billet (about x 0.02, y 0.15, z 0.47) so the blow hits a real surface.

farmer.summary: The farmer model matches the mmx mockup well: a wide straw hat, a straw bundle in the mouth, a red plaid shirt, patched blue overalls, and a tall pitchfork. The work clip now reads as fork work: a stab into the soil, a lever, a lift of a hay clump, and a toss to his left. The short chibi arms limit the stab angle and the toss.
strengths: The wide straw hat and the tall pitchfork make a silhouette that reads as a farmer at once, also in the 128 px sprites.
The work clip uses targets: both hands hold the haft, the tines go 10 cm into the soil, and a hay clump rides from the lever to the toss.
The check passes: no held item goes through the head, and no clip sinks below the ground.
issues: The stab tilts the fork only 36 degrees down, not 55: the fork is 1 m long and the arms are 17 cm long, so a steeper fork hits the head.
The rig has no knees. The hips drop 5.6 cm because the pant legs squash, and the lean is small, so the crouch is weak in the three-quarter view.
At the toss the left fist moves up to 5 cm off the haft axis, and the haft touches the shirt, the overalls, and a brass button by up to 0.9 cm.
next: Add knee bones to the legs, so the stab can bend the knees and drop the hips more.
Make the fork shorter or move the top hand nearer the butt end, so the stab can tilt the fork more and keep both hands on the haft in the toss.

guard.summary: The town guard now matches the mmx mockup in form and in color. He has a gunmetal kettle helmet with a crest, a large round nose, and a brown handlebar mustache with tips that curl up. He wears a teal-blue tabard with a gold tower over dark mail. His spear has a thin spike on a small collar and a deep teal swallowtail pennant. The thrust uses two hands in a side-on stance.
strengths: The face reads as in the mockup. The nose is 25 percent larger, it is a separate round bulb with a rosy tip, and the mustache tips curl up beside the cheeks.
The colors follow the mockup. The steel is gunmetal (#7a8088), the mail is darker (#5e646c), and the tabard is teal blue (#4d8898). The gold tower and the pennant stay clear against the tabard.
The spear has a thin spike on a small collar above the socket and the rings, as in the mockup. The check gives result ok and ground ok.
issues: Under the render light, the helmet and the gauntlets still show bright highlights, so the steel reads a little lighter than the matte gunmetal of the mockup.
The chibi left arm is short. In the drive, the haft slides through the left hand, and the left shoulder moves forward up to 4.5 cm.
The right vambrace goes 0.4 cm into the tabard at phase 0.43 of the death.
next: Move the right elbow out in the death at phase 0.43, so the vambrace clears the tabard.
Raise the steel roughness a little (about 0.45), so the helmet reads as matte gunmetal in the sprites.

skeleton-mage.summary: The skeleton mage matches the candle-skull caster on the mockup. The cast now has a strong release: the palm flame shrinks, swells, and flares to 1.8 times its size, and a purple bolt flies 0.6 m toward the target. At the end of the death, the eyes and the candle flame go out as the skull stops. All clips pass the head check and the ground check. The model has 43,728 triangles.
strengths: The candle on the skull is a unique silhouette. It shows clearly in all 8 sprite directions.
The cast reads as a spell: an anticipation, a flare of the palm flame, a bolt that leaves the hand, and a recovery.
The death is clear: a stagger, a collapse into a heap, the staff falls, the skull rolls off, and the lights go out.
issues: The bolt is small (about 5 cm wide). At 128 px, it shows as only a few purple pixels for one or two frames.
In the idle, the staff comes to 0.5 cm from the wax on the skull. It passes the check, but the margin is small.
The candle is a wide block with a flat top, and the skull has no hood. The mockup has a taller, rounder candle and a dark hood.
next: Make the candle taller and rounder, and add a dark hood behind the skull, as on the mockup.
Tilt the staff out a little more in the idle, so that it stays 1 cm or more from the wax.

imp.summary: The imp matches the imp on the Chibi Quest enemy sheet. It is a big-headed red devil with dark horns, amber eyes, fangs, bat wings, claws, and a spade tail. The attack is a clear claw strike with a 0.12 s hold at full reach, and the wing beat has a sweep and a twist. The flat light membranes and the thin leading bone remain open.
strengths: The spread bat wings and the curved horns give a spiky silhouette that reads in all eight sprite directions.

The attack has three clear parts. The imp rises with the claws beside the head and the wings up, dives forward with a hard downstroke, holds both claws at full forward reach for 0.12 s, and rakes down.
One shared wing helper sweeps the tip back at the top and forward at the bottom and twists the wing. In fly, the side and three-quarter views show the membrane in every frame.
issues: In the three-quarter view, the reaching claws are small against the big head. The strike reads in two sprite frames, but it does not stand out strongly.
The membranes are one flat light orange (#e0704a), lighter than the skin, with sharp star points. The mockup membranes are darker red-orange with rounded scallops.
The leading bone is dark and thick only to the knuckle. From the knuckle to the top tip it is a thin finger.
next: Darken the membranes toward the wing tips with C.membraneDark and carry the thick dark leading bone from the knuckle to the top wing tip.
Spread the claw fingers wider during the hold so that the strike reads more strongly at 128 px.

skeleton-archer.summary: The skull has two rows of separate rounded teeth (8 in each row) in a dark mouth, as in the mockup. The nose is 2 cm higher, with bone between the nose and the teeth. The bow limbs are 1.5 times thicker, and each limb is a recurve: it bends back to the string at the nock, then the tip curls forward into a hook. The grip, the nocks, and the clips did not change. The check passes (result ok, ground ok).
strengths: The grin reads at 128 px: light teeth on a dark mouth, with a dark line between the rows. The close views show a dark gap between each pair of teeth.
The bow reads as a recurve in the front view and in the sprites: thick dark limbs, and a hook at each tip.
The string touches the limbs only at the nocks, so the string bones and the draw in the attack clip did not change.
issues: The bow stands upright at the side. The mockup holds the bow across the body, horizontal, at hip height.
The lower bow tip curls close to the ground beside the left boot.
Old small lines remain: the red wraps go 0.8 cm into the mantle at attack phase 0.29-0.30, the wraps and the hand go 0.4 cm into the cloak, and the arrow goes 0.3 cm into the quiver.
next: Keep the red wraps out of the mantle hem at attack phase 0.29-0.30.
Look at the nock (attack phase 0.3) with the thicker upper limb, and keep the limb off the right cheek.

giant-rat.summary: The giant rat matches the front of its mmx mockup: round pink-lined ears, red eyes under angry brows, a pink nose, buck teeth, head spikes, back tufts, a red neckerchief, and a ringed tail. The attack is now a real bite: a crouch, a dart with the jaws open, and a hard snap.
strengths: The round ears, the head spikes, the back tufts, and the long tail give a clear silhouette from every side and in all 8 sprite directions.
A lower jaw on a jaw bone opens 35 degrees in the dart. The open mouth shows a dark inside, a tongue, lower teeth, and the buck teeth. At rest the grin looks the same as before.

The attack has a crouch with the claws back beside the chest, a 15 cm dart with a step of the left foot, a claw rake, and a snap with a nod down. IK keeps the feet planted, and the back foot rolls onto its toes.
issues: In the side view, the snout is still short and flat, and the body stands upright. The sides and the belly are smooth, with no fur clumps or folds.
A faint seam line shows on the chin below the grin corners at close zoom, where the jaw separates from the head. It does not show at sprite size.
The tail slides 15 cm on the ground with the hips during the dart. In the crouch, the hands fold back with the claws up, which reads less clearly in the side view.
next: Push the snout and the nose 0.03 m forward, and lean the chest and the head forward. Add fur clumps along the sides and belly folds in the paint.
Use the jaw in the other clips: a squeal with the mouth open in the hit, a small chew in the idle sniff, and a slack jaw in the death.

giant-bat.summary: The giant bat matches the front of its mmx mockup: a round purple fur ball, tall ears, yellow eyes under heavy brows, a pink snout, fangs, and pink wings. The attack is now a real swooping bite with a lower jaw that opens and snaps shut.
strengths: A jaw bone moves a small lower lip under the grin. The closed mouth at rest looks the same as before. When the jaw opens, a dark throat, a tongue, and two lower fangs show.
The attack has a clear wind-up, a swoop 0.3 m forward with a pitch of 14 degrees or less, a wide open mouth, a hard snap, and a climb back to the hover with strong wing beats.
The idle, the hit, and the death still read well. No clip sinks below the ground, and the build gives no warnings.
issues: The open lower jaw looks ragged in close views: its top face is dark to the lip edge, and the chin fur spikes cover part of the lower lip.
The ears are still tall pointed triangles with a straight rim.
In the side view and in the W and E sprites, the wings are still thin pink fins beside the ball.
next: Round the ear outline and add two or three scallops to its back edge.
Angle the wings 20 degrees toward the front at rest, so they read in the side view and in the W and E sprites.

mimic.summary: The mimic matches its mmx mockup and uses the planks, iron, and gold lock of the treasure chest asset. The open lid is a jaw of white fangs with yellow slit eyes. Red flesh, a purple tongue, and iron claw feet complete it. This pass changed the attack clip. The chest rears back, hops 0.22 m forward, and leans 12 degrees into the bite. The lid stops 15 degrees open, so the fangs interlock at the seam at full size. The chest holds the bite for 0.1 s with a small shake, lets go, and returns to rest. The lower corner fangs moved 4 cm inward, so they stand inside the upper corner fangs and do not touch them.
strengths: The bite now shows the fangs: at the contact frame the lower teeth stand in front of the lid and the upper corner fangs dip inside the lower lip.
Closed (the first frame of the reveal clip), the mimic matches the real treasure chest, so the trap works in a level.
The death reads well. The chest shivers and gapes, the front legs buckle, then the back legs, and the lid falls shut on the limp tongue.
issues: At 128 px, the fangs at the bite are small white marks. The bite reads best in the S, SW, and SE sprites and is weak in the side sprites.
The mockup shows gold coins and cloth in the flesh; the model has only flesh. The teeth are still straight cones with thin bases.
The chest body is a square box; the mockup chest flares out toward the top. The iron bands are blue-black; the mockup iron is a warm dark gray-brown.
next: Add a few gold coins and a gem in the flesh, from the treasure heap of the chest. This item from the old review is still open.
Make the tooth bases thicker and bend the middle teeth a little toward the front, so the bite reads more strongly at 128 px.

animated-armor.summary: The animated armor matches its mmx mockup: a huge round great helm with a brass band, a black visor with two cyan eyes, and a slotted face plate. This pass changed the model and not the clips. A raised brass brow now follows the dome over the visor slit and turns down at its ends. The cheek plates flare out by up to 2.8 cm at the bottom. A second, low-frequency noise gathers the rust specks into larger patches on the helm dome and the pauldrons, with a faint dark stain around them. The dark steel stays the main value. ./forge check gives result ok (head margin 0.3 cm) and ground ok.
strengths: The two cyan eyes on the black visor read at once. The new brass brow puts a shadow line over the visor slit, as in the mockup.
The rust now reads as weathered plate: speck clusters and dark stains on the helm dome and the pauldrons, with clean steel between them.
The clips stay as before: the diagonal slash, the loose helm in the hit, and the death where the suit falls apart into a pile.
issues: The brow is brass like the band, so it reads as a thicker lower edge of the band more than as a separate ridge.
The cheek flare is small. The sword fist passes just under the cheek plates in the attack (0.3 cm margin), so a larger flare needs a change to the attack path.
In the attack, the top of the backswing is behind the helm in the front view, so the front sprite shows mainly the follow-through.
next: Move the attack wrist path about 2 cm lower or farther out under the helm rim, then flare the cheek plates more.
Look at the 128 px sprites to make sure that the rust patches do not turn into noise at sprite size.
